title: Mango Jam
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: In blender,add mangoes and blend until pureed & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Blender mein aam dal dein aur blend ker ka puree tayyar ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In saucepan,add sugar,water and mix well on low flame until sugar dissolves (don’t cover cook the mixture).
steps.romanUrdu: Saucepan mein cheeni aur pani dal ker halki ancch per cheeni ghul janay tak ache tarhan mix ker lein (mixture ko ziyada nahi pakana hai).

steps.instruction: Add mango puree and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Mango puree dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add lemon zest,mix well and cook for 2-3 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Lemon zest dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 2-3 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add lemon juice and mix well until thickens (approx. 15 minutes) and check by plate technique method.
steps.romanUrdu: Lemon juice dal dein aur garha hunay tak ache tarhan mix kertay rahein (approx. 15 minutes) & plate technique method sa check ker lein.

steps.instruction: Let it cool and store in a dry & clean airtight jar for up to 2 weeks in refrigerator.
steps.romanUrdu: Thanda ker lein aur dry & clean airtight jar mein dal ker 2 weeks kliya refrigerate mein store ker saktay han.

ogDescription: Make your own Mango Jam at home with this recipe. Let the kids enjoy . #HappyCookingToYou
